clausula: La RT-qPCR combina la transcripción reversa del ARN viral a ADN complementario con la amplificación cuantitativa en tiempo real
evidencia_textual: "viral RNA copies were enumerated using reverse transcriptase quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR)" (p.2); "iTaq™ Universal Probes One-Step Reaction Mix ... 0.50 μL of iScript advanced reverse transcriptase" (p.3)
nota: Ahmed usa RT-qPCR en un paso con transcriptasa reversa; no define el principio (ADNc + amplificación en tiempo real), que es una descripción genérica no textual.

clausula: En vigilancia de aguas residuales la señal se estima mediante el Cq y la concentración calculada a partir de curvas estándar
evidencia_textual: "gBlocks gene fragments ... used as standards or positive controls" (p.3); "The slope of the standards for N_Sarbeco and NIID_2019-nCOV_N assays were −2.99 and −3.10" (p.6); "The Cq values of the WWTP B1 and B2 samples were 37.5 and 39, corresponding to 12 and 1.9 copies/100 mL of untreated wastewater" (p.6)
nota: Cq convertido a copias mediante estándares; la frase LaTeX tiene redacción defectuosa ('mediante ... mediante').

clausula: Su uso fue central desde los primeros reportes de SARS-CoV-2 en aguas residuales
evidencia_textual: "First confirmed detection of SARS-CoV-2 in untreated wastewater in Australia" (p.2); "First study that reports the detection of SARS-CoV-2 in wastewater in Australia." (p.2)
nota: Ahmed es la primera detección en Australia (no en el mundo) y usa RT-qPCR; 'central desde los primeros reportes' es una generalización no declarada.

clausula: La RT-qPCR sigue siendo el paso que confirma la presencia viral
evidencia_textual: "The presence of SARS-CoV-2 was confirmed by sequencing." (p.2); "Since wastewater is a complex matrix and some assays may produce false-positive results, we recommend sequencing RT-qPCR products for confirmation." (p.7)
nota: Ahmed sostiene lo contrario: la confirmación la da la secuenciación de los productos de RT-qPCR, no la RT-qPCR.

clausula: Los controles negativos detectan contaminación y los positivos verifican el desempeño del ensayo
evidencia_textual: "All positive and negative controls were positive and negative, respectively, indicating assays performed well and without contamination." (p.4); "RNA extraction and PCR negative and positive controls were included to ensure no contamination" (p.3)
nota: Oración-lista sin cita propia; la cita Hughes está en la oración siguiente, pero el contenido se sostiene.

clausula: Los controles de recuperación evalúan las pérdidas durante el procesamiento
evidencia_textual: "BCoV was spiked into the samples and used as an additional recovery control; all samples were required to have greater than 10% BCoV recovery." (p.3); "BCoV recoveries were higher than 10% ... suggesting an efficient and acceptable recovery of RNA during RNA extraction" (p.4)

clausula: Los marcadores de normalización corrigen las variaciones por dilución y carga de sólidos
evidencia_textual: "Normalizing by PMMoV can serve to correct for sample-to-sample changes in RNA extraction efficiency, concentrations during storage, or differences in the fecal strength of the wastewater" (p.4)
nota: PMMoV corrige eficiencia de extracción, almacenamiento y fuerza fecal (equivalente a dilución); 'carga de sólidos' no aparece.

clausula: Hughes et al. analizaron RSV en sólidos sedimentados con controles de recuperación
evidencia_textual: "(PMMoV), and bovine coronavirus (BCoV) recovery ... PMMoV is highly abundant in human stool ... recovery and fecal strength control for the wastewater samples" (p.3)

clausula: Hughes et al. incorporaron evaluación de inhibición
evidencia_textual: "followed by PCR inhibitor removal with the Zymo OneStep-96 PCR Inhibitor Removal kit" (p.2)
nota: Hughes describe remoción de inhibidores, no una evaluación de inhibición.

clausula: Hughes et al. normalizaron con PMMoV
evidencia_textual: "We repeated the analysis normalizing RSV RNA concentrations by PMMoV and found similar results." (p.4)

clausula: Las limitaciones en aguas residuales surgen de los inhibidores de amplificación, la degradación del ARN y las cargas cercanas al límite de detección
evidencia_textual: "Inhibitory substances in the sample can suppress PCR amplification partially or completely, resulting in incorrect quantification or false-negative results" (p.19); "several studies have documented nucleic acid degradation of SARS-CoV-2 and other viruses associated with both freezing and warming of wastewater" (p.9)
otra_fuente: MejiaCalle_2024 p.40 ("observed CT values were relatively late, likely due to viral RNA fragmentation")
nota: Sin cita propia (la cita Parkins cierra el párrafo); inhibidores y degradación se sostienen, el límite de detección no aparece como limitación en Parkins.

clausula: En la PTAR Quitumbe se secuenciaron 36 de 47 muestras y 11 quedaron sin secuenciar por Cq muy tardíos
evidencia_textual: "A total of 47 samples were collected using the 3D-printed passive devices. Of these, only 36 samples could be sequenced, as the remaining 11 samples had very late CT values, which prevented successful sequencing." (p.45)

clausula: Mejía-Calle incluyó muestras con Cq superiores a 38, por encima del umbral de 35 que aplicaba la mayoría de los estudios revisados
evidencia_textual: "approximately 15 of the 47 samples processed for the N1 and N2 genes had late Ct values (>38). Most studies reviewed only samples sequenced with Ct values less than 35, but in this study, samples with higher Ct values were sequenced." (p.56)

clausula: La carga detectada por RT-qPCR determinó qué muestras avanzaron a secuenciación
evidencia_textual: "we successfully assigned lineages to all sequenced samples by selecting them based on their Ct values obtained through qPCR" (p.58); "the Ct values used to select sequenced samples likely prioritized those with higher viral loads" (p.60)

clausula: La detección molecular se interpreta junto con los controles de calidad y las características del flujo de procesamiento de cada muestra
evidencia_textual: "collection and use of wastewater-associated “metadata” are often useful during quality assurance and data interpretation" (p.10); "To assess the impact of these factors on reducing PCR efficiency, an internal control should be assessed in each sample." (p.18)

clausula: La PCR múltiple amplifica varios blancos en una misma reacción o en un flujo coordinado de amplificación
evidencia_textual: "amplified in a multiplex tiling PCR with specific primers, generating 39 amplicons ~ 550 bp" (p.1); "amplified in a multiplex tiling PCR in two primer pools" (p.2)

clausula: En vigilancia viral la PCR múltiple permite detectar distintos patógenos
nota: Le_2025 trabaja solo con RSV; no menciona detección de varios patógenos. Child_2023 p.1 señala lo opuesto para métodos dirigidos ("limited to the surveillance of target viruses in a single assay").

clausula: La PCR múltiple permite diferenciar subgrupos
evidencia_textual: "The usage of RSV-A and RSV-B pan-subtype primers improve the handling performance, compared to subtype-specific protocols" (p.6); "an automatic RSV subtype detection ... the RSVTyper aligns all reads against a panel of RSV-A and RSV-B sequences" (p.3)
nota: Los cebadores son pan-subtipo; la diferenciación de subgrupos la hace el paso bioinformático, no la PCR.

clausula: La PCR múltiple genera conjuntos de amplicones que cubren regiones extensas del genoma
evidencia_textual: "we designed 126 RSV-specific primers (65 in pool 1 and 61 in pool 2), generating 39 overlapping amplicons" (p.2)

clausula: Reduce el costo y el tiempo de procesamiento
evidencia_textual: "amplicon-based methods are inexpensive to implement and can be performed with standard laboratory equipment" (p.7); "Hybridization capture techniques are ... more expensive to implement, more time-consuming" (p.6); "Nanopore sequencing ... allows rapid analysis during sequencing" (p.8)
nota: Costo bajo sostenido; el menor tiempo se dice de la captura híbrida por contraste y del análisis Nanopore, no de la PCR múltiple.

clausula: Puede realizarse con equipamiento de laboratorio estándar
evidencia_textual: "amplicon-based methods are inexpensive to implement and can be performed with standard laboratory equipment" (p.7)

clausula: Los paneles de amplicones solapados aumentan la probabilidad de recuperar el genoma a partir de ARN degradado o de escasa abundancia
evidencia_textual: "Whole genome sequencing (WGS) via PCR can provide high sensitivity for viral detection in degraded samples, such as those from wastewater" (p.2); "These results demonstrated the high sensitivity of tiled PCR for sequencing viruses with very low abundance in wastewater samples." (p.8); "nucleic acid degradation in wastewater samples, which can restrict the contiguous binding of primer pairs" (p.11)
pagina_traza: Child_2023 p.2; Child_2023 p.8; Child_2023 p.11
otra_fuente: Le_2025 p.7 ("smaller amplicons are more robust regarding low RNA quality")
nota: Baja abundancia sostenida; para ARN degradado Child muestra que la degradación redujo el éxito de los esquemas de 1,2 kb (NoVGII, HAdV41).

clausula: Le et al. aplicaron para RSV un panel de 39 amplicones solapados de ~550 pb
evidencia_textual: "generating 39 amplicons ~ 550 bp in length, and sequenced with Oxford Nanopore Technologies" (p.1); "generating 39 overlapping amplicons" (p.2)
nota: En p.2 el diseño se describe como ~500 pb; el resumen dice ~550 pb.

clausula: Mediante secuenciación Nanopore y análisis automático
evidencia_textual: "Sequencing reads of patient isolates were analyzed with the RSVTyper pipeline, a tailored analysis pipeline" (p.1); "an automatic RSV subtype detection as a first step" (p.3)

clausula: Un positivo con Cq tardío requiere cautela cuando la carga es baja o la matriz contiene inhibidores que suprimen la amplificación
evidencia_textual: "Inhibitory substances in the sample can suppress PCR amplification partially or completely, resulting in incorrect quantification or false-negative results" (p.19); "One common definition for inhibited PCR reaction is a different amplification profile with 2 Cts greater than the expected Ct values" (p.19)
otra_fuente: Ahmed_2020 p.7 ("some assays may produce false-positive results, we recommend sequencing RT-qPCR products")
nota: Parkins sostiene que los inhibidores suprimen la amplificación y retrasan el Ct; no formula la cautela sobre positivos con Cq tardío.

clausula: Un negativo puede reflejar ausencia del blanco
evidencia_textual: "MeV and HAV were also absent in metagenomic libraries from all samples, suggesting that they were not present in sufficient quantities for PCR detection in the wastewater samples tested." (p.8)

clausula: Un negativo puede reflejar una unión deficiente de los cebadores a un ARN degradado
evidencia_textual: "may have been caused by nucleic acid degradation in wastewater samples, which can restrict the contiguous binding of primer pairs to DNA/cDNA fragments" (p.11)

clausula: Los sesgos de amplificación favorecen ciertas regiones o linajes
evidencia_textual: "changes in primer recognition sites may have affected the results by targeting more conserved viral regions, leading to the detection of ancestral lineages" (p.46); "only the conserved part of the virus was being sequenced in samples from March to August, resulting in the assignment of a more primitive lineage" (p.49)

clausula: Mejía-Calle asoció los cambios de cebadores con la afectación de la representación de variantes minoritarias
evidencia_textual: "July 2024, which impacted the detection of circulating lineages and led to the identification of primitive lineages" (p.61); "the Ct values used to select sequenced samples likely prioritized those with higher viral loads, which may have excluded low-abundance lineages" (p.60)
nota: El cambio de cebadores se asocia a asignación de linajes primitivos; la pérdida de linajes de baja abundancia la atribuye a la selección por Ct, no a los cebadores.

clausula: La secuenciación de Sanger (primera generación) lee un solo fragmento por reacción
evidencia_textual: "The Sanger method, also known as first-generation sequencing" (p.60); "Sanger sequencing is capable of producing a template sequence per reaction" (p.61); "the Sanger method only sequences a single DNA fragment at a time" (p.84)

clausula: Longitud útil de unos 700 a 900 pares de bases
evidencia_textual: "deteriorating quality of sequencing reads after 700e900 bases" (p.61)
nota: El libro habla de bases (lectura), no de pares de bases.

clausula: Durante décadas fue el estándar de la secuenciación de ADN
evidencia_textual: "the Sanger method, which represented the gold standard for DNA sequencing for approximately 40 years" (p.60)

clausula: La NGS ejecuta de millones a miles de millones de reacciones en paralelo
evidencia_textual: "NGS enables performing millions to billions of sequencing reactions simultaneously in multiple samples" (p.61)

clausula: Reconstruye las lecturas mediante bioinformática en comparación con un genoma de referencia
evidencia_textual: "Bioinformatics analyses are then used to piece together these fragments by mapping the individual reads to the human reference genome." (p.84)

clausula: La secuenciación profunda detecta variantes a frecuencias alélicas más bajas que Sanger
evidencia_textual: "the ability to detect variants at lower allele frequencies than with Sanger sequencing" (p.61); "With deep sequencing, NGS also has a higher discovery capability for detecting novel or rare variants." (p.84)

clausula: Esa ventaja permite detectar linajes minoritarios que coexisten en una muestra de aguas residuales que mezcla genomas de muchos individuos
evidencia_textual: "the ability to detect variants at lower allele frequencies than with Sanger sequencing" (p.61)
otra_fuente: Karthikeyan_2022 p.3 ("Wastewater systems aggregate stool, urine and other biological waste products carrying viruses from multiple infected individuals")
nota: Dash (libro forense) no menciona aguas residuales ni linajes; la aplicación a mezclas de aguas residuales es inferencia de la autora.

clausula: Según la longitud de lectura, la NGS se divide en segunda generación (lecturas cortas) y tercera generación (lecturas largas en tiempo real)
evidencia_textual: "Depending on the length of sequences produced second- and third-generation sequencing methods are available, and they are defined as short-read and real-time long-read technologies, respectively" (p.61)

clausula: La secuenciación por nanoporos pertenece a la tercera generación
evidencia_textual: "The introduction of nanopore sequencing, a third-generation sequencing system" (p.110)
nota: Cláusula posterior a la cita; se sostiene en Dash.

clausula: ONT mide los cambios de corriente eléctrica generados cuando una molécula de ácido nucleico atraviesa un nanoporo
evidencia_textual: "The presence of a DNA molecule alters the ionic current by partially blocking the aperture. As each nucleotide modifies the current in a slightly different way, the obtained current profile, called a ‘squiggle’, can be translated to a nucleotide sequence" (p.111)

clausula: Produce lecturas largas en tiempo real
evidencia_textual: "individual DNA molecules are sequenced in real-time without the intervention of a polymerase enzyme" (p.111); "This long-read sequencing yields reads spanning more than 500 nucleotides." (p.110)

clausula: En dispositivos portátiles como el MinION
evidencia_textual: "ONT commercializes a handheld sequencing device, the MinION, at a negligible cost" (p.110); "The smallest device is the MinION, which weighs less than 0.5 kg." (p.112)

clausula: Útiles para la vigilancia genómica de brotes y de muestras ambientales en contextos con infraestructura variable
evidencia_textual: "the device’s small footprint allows for sequencing in remote locations, e.g., at a crime scene" (p.110); "the low cost of the platform enables laboratory-based sequencing in regions where access to costly NGS devices is limited" (p.116)
nota: Dash sostiene uso en lugares remotos y con acceso limitado (contexto forense); no menciona vigilancia de brotes ni muestras ambientales.

clausula: Nanopore se ha aplicado a SARS-CoV-2 en la PTAR Quitumbe
evidencia_textual: "SARS-CoV-2 detection was performed using real-time PCR, and multiplex PCR was used for sequencing with Oxford Nanopore Technology." (p.10)

clausula: Nanopore se ha aplicado a poliovirus derivado de vacuna en el alcantarillado de Londres
evidencia_textual: "We additionally implemented direct molecular detection and determined whole-genome sequences of every isolate using novel nanopore protocols." ; "118 genetically linked poliovirus isolates related to the serotype 2 Sabin vaccine strain were detected in 21 of 52 sequential sewage samples collected in London" (p.1, PIIS0140673622018049.pdf)
nota: Verificado contra el artículo original (PIIS0140673622018049.pdf), no contra el comentario de Hill y Pollard. Los aislados son relacionados con Sabin 2; solo 20 de 118 cumplen el criterio VDPV.

clausula: Nanopore se ha aplicado a genomas completos de RSV
evidencia_textual: "generating 39 amplicons ~ 550 bp in length, and sequenced with Oxford Nanopore Technologies" (p.1)

clausula: Lo que permite procesar los tres virus en un mismo flujo de secuenciación
nota: Inferencia de la autora; ninguna de las tres fuentes procesa más de un virus ni propone un flujo común.

clausula: El basecalling traduce la señal de corriente, con cinco a siete nucleótidos en el poro a la vez
evidencia_textual: "This process is called base calling and is performed by machine learning algorithms. Advanced computational methodologies are necessary, as at each moment in time, a sequence of 5e7 nucleotides is present in a pore" (p.111-112)

clausula: La tasa de error cruda es mayor que la de las plataformas de lectura corta
evidencia_textual: "As the error rate of nanopore reads is higher compared to most NGS methods" (p.116); "The first important challenge is the raw read accuracy, which is still lower than Illumina sequencing." (p.119)

clausula: Sobre todo en homopolímeros
evidencia_textual: "Sequencing using the R9 nanopores ... proved to be troublesome for DNA strands containing homopolymers" (p.112); "A considerable portion of these errors could be attributed to homopolymeric stretches." (p.116)

clausula: Esa tasa solo baja del 1 % con las celdas R10.4 y el kit Q20+
evidencia_textual: "the R10.4 version was the most recent flow cell version, with a modal accuracy above 99% reported when used in combination with the so-called ‘Q20þ’ sequencing kit" (p.119)
nota: Exactitud modal >99 % equivale a error <1 %; el 'solo' es énfasis de la autora (Dash p.116 reporta además ~1,00 % de error en ADNmt).

clausula: El control de calidad y la generación de un consenso reducen su impacto
evidencia_textual: "a well-performing data-analysis workflow is crucial to obtain highly accurate consensus sequences" (p.116-117); "Reads are first filtered based on quality and size ... A consensus read is then constructed" (p.117)

clausula: Karthikeyan et al. siguieron en el alcantarillado de San Diego el recambio de Delta por Ómicron y sus sublinajes
evidencia_textual: "In more recent San Diego-wide data collected from September 2021 to February 2022, we studied ongoing transmission of the Delta variant and the rapid spread of the Omicron variant and its sublineages." (p.1)

clausula: En RSV la diversidad estacional obliga a mapear contra un panel de diez referencias de RSV-A y diez de RSV-B
evidencia_textual: "we decided to create our own reference panel consisting of 10 RSV-A and 10 RSV-B references" (p.3); "Due to the high diversity of RSV, analysis of the sequencing reads relative to a single reference would not lead to reliable results. Thus, a panel of 20 representative RSV reference sequences, comprising 10 sequences for each subtype" (p.10)
nota: Panel 10+10 exacto; la justificación es la diversidad del RSV y las diferencias en el consenso (duplicación del gen G), no la diversidad 'estacional'.

clausula: El subtipo de referencia equivocado hace caer la cobertura de 50 000 a menos de 10 lecturas por posición
evidencia_textual: "particularly problematic in regions between nt 4,200-5,800 and nt 7,600-7,800, where the mapping frequency dropped from 50,000x to < 10x or from 2,000x to 0, when the wrong reference was used" (p.3)
nota: Cifras correctas pero restringidas a la región nt 4.200-5.800, no a todo el genoma; el problema del subtipo se resolvió con la detección automática de subtipo, no con el panel de 20.

clausula: En poliovirus la distancia de la región VP1 a la cepa Sabin fecha cada aislado
evidencia_textual: "The European cVDPV2 strains form a separate cluster within NIE-ZAS-1 branching pattern and showed 13 VP1 nt differences from the parent cluster suggesting at least 1 year of undetected circulation" (p.4)
nota: Böttcher infiere tiempo de circulación no detectada a partir de diferencias VP1 con el clúster parental, no fecha cada aislado por su distancia a Sabin.

clausula: Los cVDPV2 detectados en Europa en 2024 acumularon entre 43 y 52 diferencias respecto a Sabin 2
evidencia_textual: "All cVDPV2 strains were genetically related to each other and showed 43–52 VP1 nt differences from the Sabin 2 vaccine reference strain." (p.4)
nota: Diferencias nucleotídicas en VP1 (la tesis omite que son en VP1 en esa cláusula, aunque el contexto lo implica).

clausula: La señal en aguas residuales es poblacional porque una muestra contiene genomas de múltiples individuos y de distintos estados de infección
evidencia_textual: "Wastewater systems aggregate stool, urine and other biological waste products carrying viruses from multiple infected individuals in the community in a single location" (p.3)
nota: Sin cita propia en la oración; 'múltiples individuos' se sostiene en Karthikeyan, 'distintos estados de infección' no aparece.

clausula: Crits-Christoph et al. recuperaron genomas de consenso completos (cobertura >99 %) en 7 de 22 muestras
evidencia_textual: "We obtained complete consensus SARS-CoV-2 genomes (breadth of coverage >99%) from 7 of 22 samples (31%)" (p.3)

clausula: Únicamente con Cq inferior a 33
evidencia_textual: "Only samples with RT-qPCR CT values <33 (~25 genome copies/ml) yielded complete consensus genomes" (p.3)

clausula: Con el SARS-CoV-2 entre el 0 y el 14 % de las lecturas
evidencia_textual: "We detected SARS-CoV-2 at various abundances of sequenced RNA/DNA (0 to 14%) across samples" (p.2)
nota: Valor tras enriquecimiento por captura de oligos (panel respiratorio de Illumina).

clausula: Karthikeyan et al. desarrollaron Freyja porque pangolin y UShER, pensados para muestras clínicas con un único linaje dominante, no estiman las abundancias de una mezcla
evidencia_textual: "pangolin and UShER, were designed for clinical samples containing a single dominant variant, and cannot estimate relative abundances of multiple SARS-CoV-2 lineages in samples with virus mixtures such as wastewater." (p.1)

clausula: Freyja deconvoluciona la proporción de cada linaje a partir de una biblioteca de mutaciones definitorias
evidencia_textual: "Freyja uses a ‘barcode’ library of lineage-defining mutations to represent each SARS-CoV-2 lineage in the global phylogeny" (p.3)

clausula: Sobre muestras con más del 70 % de cobertura
evidencia_textual: "Analysis was only performed on samples with greater than 70% coverage, with the exception of March samples from the UCSD for which all samples with greater than 50% coverage were used." (p.10)
nota: Con excepción de muestras de marzo (>50 %).

clausula: Freyja pondera la profundidad desigual entre amplicones para no sobrerrepresentar los minoritarios
evidencia_textual: "As SNV frequencies at positions with greater sequencing depth more accurately estimate the true mutation frequency, Freyja recovers relative lineage abundance by solving a depth-weighted least absolute deviation regression problem" ; "providing robustness to common attributes of real sequencing data such as heavily skewed read depth across amplicons" (p.3)
nota: La ponderación por profundidad y la robustez ante profundidad sesgada entre amplicones se sostienen; 'para no sobrerrepresentar los minoritarios' no aparece.

clausula: Detectar un linaje minoritario depende de la cobertura del genoma y de las regiones diagnósticas
evidencia_textual: "many sequences could not be assigned, possibly due to coverage of amplicon regions not containing variations required for differentiation of genotypes" (p.9); "the additional sensitivity provided by tiled-PCR sequencing can improve the resolution of variant detection ... in wastewater samples containing variant mixtures" (p.9)
nota: Child habla de genotipado de norovirus GI y resolución de variantes en mezclas, no específicamente de linajes minoritarios.

clausula: Los controles bioinformáticos acotan los falsos positivos por error de secuenciación o contaminación cruzada
evidencia_textual: "False-positive SNPs can arise from sequencing errors, PCR duplicates, or rare variants. Therefore, it is important to filter out low-quality SNPs or those with low coverage." (p.134); "These errors can result from sequencing errors, PCR biases, or sample contamination." (p.137)
nota: Contexto de microhaplotipos forenses; Dash dice 'sample contamination', no 'cross-contamination' en este pasaje.

clausula: El demultiplexado separa las lecturas de cada muestra por sus índices i7 e i5 de ocho bases
evidencia_textual: "The unique forward and reverse adapter i7 and i5 index sequence combinations are added to the targets to label them for demultiplexing" ; "An index, which is similar to a barcode, is made up of an 8-bp sequence that is used to demultiplex the sample data once it has been sequenced." (p.92)
nota: Contexto: biblioteca ForenSeq de Illumina; los índices i7/i5 no aplican a Nanopore.

clausula: Sigue con el recorte de adaptadores, el filtrado por calidad y el mapeo o ensamblaje del consenso
evidencia_textual: "Preprocessing the data to remove adapter sequences and low-quality reads, mapping the data to a reference genome or de novo alignment of the sequence reads" (p.31); "Low-quality reads should be removed, and adapter sequences should be trimmed to ensure accurate read alignment." (p.134)

clausula: Nanopore genera lecturas largas y orienta su control a la longitud
evidencia_textual: "This long-read sequencing yields reads spanning more than 500 nucleotides." (p.110); "Reads are first filtered based on quality and size" (p.117)
nota: Lecturas largas sostenidas; el filtrado Nanopore descrito es por calidad y tamaño, no orientado a la longitud en exclusiva.

clausula: Illumina produce lecturas cortas pareadas de unas 150 bases por extremo
evidencia_textual: "Illumina NovaSeq (2019) ... 2 × 50 – 2 × 150 bp" (p.67); "NextSeq 550 series 2 × 150 bp" (p.280); "MiSeq FGX ... 2 × 300 bp" (p.280)
nota: 2×150 es una configuración de varias tablas; Dash reporta rangos de 2×50 a 2×300 según el equipo.

clausula: El control de calidad de Illumina se concentra en la calidad por base y en el emparejamiento de los extremos
nota: No se halló en Dash un pasaje que describa control de calidad por base ni emparejamiento de extremos para Illumina.

clausula: Child et al. compararon metagenómica shotgun, captura híbrida y PCR por amplicones en el mismo influente
evidencia_textual: "total nucleic acid samples extracted from influent wastewater were sequenced using a shotgun approach" (p.3); "a tiled-PCR approach was applied to the same samples" (p.6); "the utility of metagenomic shotgun sequencing, hybrid-capture enrichment, and targeted amplicon sequencing was compared" (p.10)
pagina_traza: Child_2023 p.3; Child_2023 p.6; Child_2023 p.10

clausula: La metagenómica shotgun usó 303 millones de lecturas por muestra
evidencia_textual: "A mean sequencing depth of 303 million (SD = 9.6 million) 2× 150 bp read pairs was obtained for shotgun libraries" (p.3)
nota: Son pares de lecturas (media), no lecturas individuales.

clausula: Asignó menos del 0,6 % a virus y el 99,6 % a bacterias
evidencia_textual: "<0.6% of reads were assigned to viruses across all shotgun libraries (Fig. 1a), with a mean of 99.6% (SD = 0.5%) reads assigned to bacteria" (p.3)

clausula: La shotgun no detectó un enterovirus D68 del que la PCR por amplicones recuperó el 86 % del genoma
evidencia_textual: "a mean genome coverage breadth of 86% (SD = 4%) and depth of 11,383× ... were obtained in 8/27 wastewater samples for EV-D68 through tiled-PCR sequencing (Fig. 4b). Despite the high sequencing depth of shotgun libraries, EV-D68 was not identified in any of the samples using metagenomic methods" (p.8)
nota: 86 % es la media en 8 de 27 muestras.

clausula: La captura híbrida elevó la señal de SARS-CoV-2 entre 3 000 y 97 000 veces
evidencia_textual: "when SARS-CoV-2 reads were identified in shotgun libraries, this fold increase was between 3,000 and 97,000×" (p.5)
nota: Incremento en el porcentaje de lecturas alineadas.

clausula: La captura híbrida superó el 50 % de cobertura en ocho muestras
evidencia_textual: "Genome coverage over 50% was observed for eight samples through hybrid capture, including one sample with 94% coverage" (p.6)

clausula: La concentración del virus en aguas residuales se cuantifica en copias de gen por mililitro
evidencia_textual: "the most useful form of WBS data is quantitative (e.g., number of gene copies/mL)" (p.7)

clausula: En alcantarillados combinados la lluvia o el deshielo multiplican el caudal entre tres y diez veces y diluyen la concentración
evidencia_textual: "in combined sewer systems, stormwater from precipitation/snowmelt enters the wastewater collection system and can increase the flow of wastewater substantially, sometimes as high as 3–10-fold at the wastewater treatment plant" (p.11)
nota: Parkins dice 'a veces hasta' 3-10 veces; la tesis lo presenta como regla.

clausula: Un muestreo compuesto de 24 horas promedia el pico diurno de descarga
evidencia_textual: "a distinct diurnal pattern is often observed caused by the population’s usage patterns ... One method to address this temporal variability is to collect a composite sample over a given period, typically 24 hours, which smooths out the temporal variability" (p.9)
nota: Oración sin cita propia; se sostiene en Parkins.

clausula: En una planta que agrega varias cuencas la señal se estabiliza
evidencia_textual: "Even at its most aggregated location (the wastewater treatment plant), a distinct diurnal pattern is often observed" ; "The farther upstream in the sewershed, the greater the temporal variability" (p.9)
nota: Sin cita propia; Parkins indica menor variabilidad en la planta pero advierte que el patrón diurno persiste.

clausula: En Austria, el estudio de 123 plantas anticipó los ingresos hospitalarios en 8,6 a 11,6 días y los de UCI en 14,8 a 17,7 días
evidencia_textual: "Schenk et al. (74) monitored SARS-CoV-2 RNA across 123 wastewater treatment plants throughout Austria and established that wastewater measurements provided a lead time relative to general hospital admissions (8.6–11.6 days) and ICU (14.8–17.7 days)" (p.6)
nota: Dato secundario (Schenk et al.) citado vía Parkins.

clausula: Los valores no son comparables entre plantas porque cada cuenca mezcla aportes domésticos, industriales y de dilución distintos
evidencia_textual: "Every downstream point thereafter typically introduces other sources of wastewater (e.g., laundry and kitchen gray water, commercial, or industrial inputs) and dilution water ... Because the wastewater of each municipality has a unique blend of these sources, it is not at this time advisable to directly compare WBS data between municipalities" (p.7)

clausula: Su lectura exige los metadatos de cada muestra: fecha, hora, volumen, caudal y clima
evidencia_textual: "Typical metadata include sample location, collection date and time, total volume collected, type of sample ..., flow data (if available), weather (especially recent rain events)" (p.10-11)

clausula: Su lectura exige la versión de las bases de datos y herramientas del análisis
evidencia_textual: "Whether or not these pipelines can identify new variants accurately relies on the underlying databases being continually updated." (p.25)
nota: Parkins menciona la actualización continua de bases de datos, no el registro de versiones de bases y herramientas como metadato.

clausula: Las limitaciones genómicas incluyen la baja concentración viral
evidencia_textual: "This suggests that IAV was both present at a very low concentration and highly fragmented in these samples, which likely explains the failure to generate amplicons" (p.8)

clausula: El ARN fragmentado
evidencia_textual: "nucleic acid degradation in wastewater samples, which can restrict the contiguous binding of primer pairs to DNA/cDNA fragments" (p.11)

clausula: El predominio de material bacteriano
evidencia_textual: "This was largely due to the dominance of bacterial material in the extracted nucleic acids from wastewater samples" (p.10)

clausula: Los sesgos de amplificación
evidencia_textual: "suggesting that it was not solely caused by differences in PCR efficiency between the amplicons" (p.8); "may require more optimization due to the increased chance of primer interactions with higher primer pool complexity" (p.11)
otra_fuente: Parkins_2023 p.25 ("this is not without biases owing to the requirement for primer-based amplification")
nota: Child alude a diferencias de eficiencia entre amplicones e interacciones de cebadores; la formulación explícita de sesgo de amplificación está en Parkins.

clausula: Los métodos dirigidos que compensan la baja abundancia viral exigen conocer de antemano el genoma buscado
evidencia_textual: "these methods are limited to the surveillance of target viruses in a single assay and require prior knowledge of the target genome(s)" (p.1)

clausula: Una planta de tratamiento representa a una población conectada al alcantarillado
evidencia_textual: "wastewater has been monitored at centralized wastewater treatment plants, providing an integrated SARS-CoV-2 signal for the entire community served by that system" (Parkins p.26); "Usually, one WWTP serves a town or a city." (Sims p.5)

clausula: Con variaciones por movilidad
evidencia_textual: "the problem posed by dynamic populations (e.g. population fluctuations due to tourism and commuters)" (Sims p.6); "it would be impossible to distinguish whether the presence of a pathogen in wastewater had stemmed from a visitor(s) passing though or from within the community itself" (Sims p.6)

clausula: Con variaciones por cobertura de red
evidencia_textual: "A significant proportion, and in some cases, the majority of homes in many of the larger urban centers of several LMIC, may not be connected to centralized sewer systems" (p.39)

clausula: Con variaciones por aportes no domésticos
evidencia_textual: "many wastewater treatment plants receive a highly variable amount of non-feces-containing wastewater from non-resident sources (i.e., commercial and industrial discharges)" (p.11)

clausula: Los datos ambientales evidencian circulación y tendencias comunitarias
evidencia_textual: "providing an integrated SARS-CoV-2 signal for the entire community served by that system" (Parkins p.26); "the presence of a pathogen in wastewater, whether from a resident in the catchment area or not, still provides critical information" (Sims p.6)

clausula: La atribución a barrios o grupos específicos requiere diseños y metadatos adicionales
evidencia_textual: "On a more “zoomed-in” scale, select areas (i.e., neighborhoods) can be monitored by sampling at maintenance holes or other access points" ; "sampling in neighborhoods and individual buildings brings unique challenges" (Parkins p.7)
nota: Parkins plantea el muestreo anidado (nested scales) para barrios; 'metadatos adicionales' es extensión menor.
